in_marathi.name: Harilal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Hari's praise
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harilal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Harilal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Hari' meaning god Vishnu and 'Lal' meaning praise. The name is a tribute to Lord Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. Harilal is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, happiness, and success.
